# Prose-heavy contract table

## What the host supplies

| Piece | Used by | Implementation contract |
|---|---|---|
| Catalog adapter | `DocumentHost.catalog: CatalogAdapter.variation(CatalogRef): CatalogVariation?` | The host adapts its existing catalog client and preserves the same immutable values used by pricing. Android forwards updates through a state stream; iOS publishes snapshots through an async stream; the browser receives the same JSON contract. Feature flags and permissions remain host-owned and must be evaluated before dispatching a command.  |
| Permission callbacks | `actor_has_permission`, `capability_enabled` | The host adapts its existing catalog client and preserves the same immutable values used by pricing.
